# Chief Medical Officer SOP
[italic]Below outlines expectations and permissions granted to a CMO given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The CMO must make sure that any revive-able corpses are revived.
[bold]2.[/bold] The CMO is permitted to carry a regular Defibrillator or a Compact Defibrillator on their person at all times.
[bold]3.[/bold] The CMO is permitted to carry a flash and their hypospray.
[bold]4.[/bold] The CMO is not permitted to allow the creation of poisonous or explosive mixtures in Chemistry without express consent from the [color=#cb0000]Head of Security[/color] or a clear and urgent danger to the station.
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold]2.[/bold] The Chief Medical Officer is permitted to carry dangerous chemicals for self-defense.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
